collections.name: Acrylic Bangles
collections.blurb: Durable, non-bendable acrylic with a high-gloss finish.
collections.story: The practical one. Acrylic survives travel, children and long days far better than glass, without giving up the shine.

collections.name: Antique Bangles
collections.blurb: Oxidised gold-tone work with temple motifs and set stones.
collections.story: Antique-finish pieces in the temple tradition — Lakshmi motifs, ruby and emerald tones, and the matte oxidised gold that only looks better with age.

collections.name: Intricate Glass Bangles
collections.blurb: Fine-cut glass with a hand-set sparkle that catches every light in the room.
collections.story: Our most detailed glass work — each bangle cut and finished by hand, then matched into sets of twelve so the tones sit together perfectly on the wrist.

collections.name: Jelly Bangles
collections.story: The jelly finish gives a soft, sweet translucency — light on the wrist and easy to layer three or four sets deep without any weight.

collections.name: Kashmiri Bangles
collections.blurb: Ornate thread and stone work in the Kashmiri tradition.
collections.story: Wrapped in coloured thread and finished with stone and gungroo detailing. These are the heirloom pieces — bought for a wedding, worn for decades.

collections.name: Pastel Palette
collections.blurb: Soft, powdery tones for everyday wear and daytime occasions.
collections.story: Built for the days that are not weddings. Muted enough for work, pretty enough that you will not want to take them off afterwards.

collections.name: Petal Stone Bangles
collections.blurb: Petal-set stones in a continuous band of colour and light.
collections.story: Every stone is seated by hand in a petal-shaped bed. It is slow work, which is why these arrive in smaller batches than the rest.

collections.name: Phool Glass Bangles
collections.blurb: A raised floral motif running the full circumference in soft relief.
collections.story: Phool means flower. The motif is pressed into the glass while it is still warm, so the pattern is part of the bangle rather than sitting on top of it.

collections.name: Side Bangles
collections.blurb: Kundan, pearl and stone bangles to flank a stack.
collections.story: Designed to frame. A side bangle sits at either end of a stack and finishes it, the way a border finishes a saree.

collections.name: Square Edge Glass Bangles
collections.blurb: A crisp squared profile that stacks flat and sits clean against the skin.
collections.story: The squared edge is deceptively hard to get right. It gives a sharper line than a rounded bangle and a quieter shine — the one our regulars keep coming back for.

collections.name: Statement Bangles
collections.blurb: Single, substantial pieces made to be the whole outfit.
collections.story: Worn one at a time. Heavier, wider and deliberately loud — the piece someone asks you about across the room.
